daily.today_energy: Your vibe is electric today, Aries. There's a restless spark in your chest asking you to try something new. Trust that impulse—it's pointing you toward growth, not chaos. Move with intention.
daily.love: Someone's been noticing you more than you realize. Whether you're single or coupled up, today calls for genuine vulnerability. Real connection happens when you drop the armor and let people see what's underneath.
daily.career: Your ideas are sharp right now, and people are listening. This is your moment to pitch, propose, or speak up in that meeting. Your confidence isn't arrogance—it's earned. Channel it wisely.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement today. Whether it's a walk, dancing, or something more intense, get out of your head and into your skin. Physical release clears mental fog like nothing else.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is all about authenticity, Aries. You're being called to lean into what actually matters to you, not what you think should matter. Trust that gut feeling—it's your superpower right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, there's a softness asking to come through. Let yourself be a little vulnerable with someone you trust. Real connection > surface level vibes, always.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different this week. Don't sleep on that creative project or way of doing things that feels unconventional. The energy supports you taking up space and being heard.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for presence, not punishment. Moving in ways that feel good—not what TikTok says you should do—is where the healing is at. Listen to what actually brings you joy.
